description.value: Chef Claire's is a well-regarded Vancouver catering company operating out of a luncheonette on Main Street, serving sandwiches, soups, salads, and sweets to walk-in customers as well as offering platters, plated dinners, and frozen take-home meals. The business has been featured in Canada.com and regional food media, and its creative menu spans gluten-free cheese selections to Moroccan spiced lamb and fennel-cured wild salmon. Cyclists passing through Main Street's corridor can stop in for a quick lunch or pick up frozen meals for the road.
